title: مخلوط مغز استخوان | Voskes
heading: MARROW MIX
description: مخلوط بیسکویت مغز استخوان، مناسب توله‌های بالای ۶ ماه و سگ بالغ؛ غنی‌شده با ویتامین‌های A، D۳ و E.
bodyDescription: Mix of marrow biscuits suitable for puppies from 6 months onwards and adult dogs.These delicious, crunchy biscuits can be given during training as a reward or simply as a snack to spoil your four-legged friend. Also ideal during the daily walk. Moreover, the biscuits are enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E !
